original.statement: ExpireAfter has moved from NodePool.Spec.Disruption to NodePool.Spec.Template.Spec and is now a drift-able field.

decision.reason: [ev-1253ff5bd0a5] says ExpireAfter moved from NodePool.Spec.Disruption to NodePool.Spec.Template.Spec. That means the environments touched by the move are those whose NodePools still set the old spec.disruption.expireAfter path. This is the canonical exposure shape for a moved or removed CRD field. The CRD validator confirms the old path is in the NodePool schema [ev-09bbe26d2f4a][ev-760ae3491f13]. The old path exists only in v1beta1, so leaving the API version out of the condition does not make it broader. Confidence is low: the CRD excerpts show no schema details, so I can't rule out a default on the old field that would also expose NodePools that never set it.
